GROK
Updated 2026-09-16
Sources: your Grok bookmark folder (1262 posts)

NEW TODAY
- Folder now 1262 posts (6 new since Sep 15)
- Official (grok Sep 15): inviting one Grok Bot user (+1) to a Starship launch — submit how you’ve integrated Bot into your work
- Testers (wholemars Sep 15): attend a Starship launch by showing off how you use Grok Bot
- Testers (GrokBotRadar Sep 15): Grok Imagine Segments panel — edit text/logo/label/background in-place instead of regenerating the whole graphic (feels more like an editor)
- Testers (testerlabor Sep 15): frames Grok 5 as having a chance at AGI / first to do so; cites SpaceXAI truth-seeking + safety priority (tester opinion)
- Testers (WR4NYGov Sep 14): Cursor Ultra usage management — avoiding Cursor/Grok models to save for Grok 4.7; heavy Grok Bot burn (>half weekly)

WHAT IT IS
- Grok is xAI / SpaceXAI's assistant: chat, voice, Imagine, Build, and the model API, in the Grok app, https://t.co/UvO8aC6o4n, and on X.
- This folder is Grok-the-product (app, models, voice, Imagine-in-Grok, plans). Separate folders exist for Grok Bot, Grok Build, and Grok Imagine.
- Grok Bot (persistent agents on a shared computer) and Grok Build (coding harness / Build mode) show up here when they ship inside SuperGrok or the Grok app.

GROK 4.6 / MODELS
- Testers (aaronburnett Sep 14): after C+++ rewrite, modeling says RL time from 4.8 could be cut ~in half for ~2T models (more % savings larger); watch release cadence once kinks ironed.
- Testers (GrokBotRadar Sep 14): 4.7 still in RL; 4.8 finishing training this week then RL; 2.5T on SpaceXAI’s new C++ stack.
- Testers (GrokBotRadar, notjazii Sep 14): roadmap rehash / AGI framing of Grok 5 (tester headline; Elon’s text was “maybe better than anything”).
- Official (elonmusk Sep 14): Roadmap — Grok 4.7 roughly on par with Opus 5.0 (not 5.1); better in some ways, worse in others; need to fix multimodal. Grok 4.8 a noticeable improvement. Grok 4.9 probably Astra/Fable class. Grok 5 maybe better than anything.
- Testers (cb_doge, XFreeze Sep 14): Grok 4.8 — 2.5T on SpaceXAI’s new C++ software stack; pretraining finishes this week then RL; 4.7 still in final refinements.
- Testers (testerlabor Sep 13): Colossus 2 still trains Imagine Video 2.0, Grok 4.7 Beta, Grok 5+.
- Testers (nima_owji Sep 14): frames Elon as saying Grok 5 will be “AGI!” (tester headline; Elon’s text was “maybe better than anything”).
- Testers (Mr_Salio, MehdiCade Sep 13): satirical “Dario slowdown / ban open-source” delay framing — joke/satire, not a real agreement.
- Official (elonmusk, grok, Microsoft365 Sep 12): Grok models in Microsoft Copilot — Word, Excel, PowerPoint (Frontier program first).
- Testers (XFreeze, joehansen Sep 12): Copilot = Grok on the office desk; Satya door-open + Elon confirm; still has to win the click.
- Testers (nima_owji, testerlabor Sep 12): 4.7 still cooking — RL length / early-quit / weak self-check; wait until 100% ready.
- Official (elonmusk Sep 11): Grok 4.7 needs a few more days — gives up too early on hard tasks / not rigorous enough self-check; possible over-penalized response length in RL.
- Testers (minchoi, LaceyPresley, testerlabor Sep 11): delay = refinement; stay on hard problems longer; don’t treat brevity as completion.
- Testers (Mr_Salio Sep 11): Sep 12 framed as end of Elon 10-day window + "grok-4-7-0907" (anticipation; then delayed).
- Testers (XFreeze Sep 11–12): intelligence-layer-across-workflow framing; SpaceXAI model-card anti-nerf jab; 4.7 soon.
- Testers (Dr_Singularity Sep 11): Millennium Prize / Grok 5 super-scientist trajectory (opinion).
- Testers (testerlabor, MehdiCade, Priyannkaaaa, XFreeze Sep 9–10): Grok 4.7 countdown ~2 days / Sat Sep 12; "grok-4-7-0907" still cited; 2.1T; Astra ~10x cheaper framing; OpenAI Pro-pause joke pull (anticipation / leak).
- Testers (Mr_Salio, Techkelvinx Sep 8): Grok 4.7 leak — release-style build id "grok-4-7-0907" reportedly staged (dated IDs previously marked Grok 4 ship days); still ~Sep 12; early talk cheaper than Astra / stronger agents / more SpaceX data (anticipation / leak).
- Testers (StatsWire Sep 7): 4.7 ~Sep 12; 2.1T; SpaceX engineering + Starlink supplemental; better token efficiency, slightly slower to serve.
- Testers (XFreeze Sep 8): Grok 4.6 #2 on updated AutomationBench-AA (agentic SaaS workflows) vs Fable 5.1 / GPT-5.6 / Kimi K3.
- Testers (joehansen Sep 7): Grok 4.6 high #2 on τ³-Banking at 50.7% (Qwen3.8 Max 51.3%; Muse Spark 1.3 max 50.5%).
- Testers (nextbigfuture Sep 8): frames GPT-6 as AGI and Grok 4.7 / Fable 5.2 as AGI or near-AGI from Dec 2026 onward (opinion).
- Grok 4.6 launched 2026-08-12. Elon: smart, fast, amazing bang for buck. Also #1 on Databricks.
- Same 1.5T base as 4.5; testers credit a big SFT + RL jump. Stronger multi-step reasoning, coding, agents, frontend taste.
- API: $2 input / $6 output per million tokens. Live in the Grok app, API, Cursor, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent. Testers: also on Perplexity and Perplexity Computer.
- Reported leads: GDPVal-AA v2, AA-Briefcase, Harvey LAB; #1 CursorBench 3.2 (Extra High 70.8% at ~$2.81/task vs Fable 5 Max 70.5% at ~$17.32); #1 VISTA; #1 MedAgentBench; testers (joehansen, XFreeze): GPQA Diamond — 4.6 high led ~95%, then #2 at 94.9% after Gemini 3.8 Flash high took #1 at 95.3% (Sep 2). Testers: 4.6 High tied Opus 5 Max at 59 on the AA Agentic Index. Artificial Analysis ~61 — testers (XFreeze, cb_doge, Sep 4): ties newly released GPT-6 Astra at 61; beats Astra Max on Agentic Index 59 vs 51, τ³-Banking 51% vs 41%, non-hallucination 66% vs 49%, GDPval-AA v2 1,730 vs 1,629. Still matches GPT-5.6 Sol at up to 5x lower API price.
- Testers (XEthanai): WANDR puts 4.6 on the Pareto frontier vs Fable 5 at >60% less cost. Standard-mode latency ~9–12 min per complex prompt; keep Fast and Extra High disabled to protect monthly limits. Non-enterprise testers say Cursor or Grok Build can be better value than the standalone API.
- Nvidia: trained and served on GB300 NVL72. SpaceXAI is writing its own C/C++ inference stacked on that silicon (XFreeze).
- Elon: 4.7 initial training done, expected to exceed current models. Testers (JayaNayak21, RoundtableSpace, astropol0, testerlabor, mark_k, tetsuoai, joehansen): ~Sep 12 / "10 days"; 2.1T (+600B vs 4.6); first real architecture/scale step (1.5T · 2.1T); coding + writing upgrades; SpaceX engineering data pass; Elon says good chance of surpassing every current model. Testers (astropol0): framed as possible Fable 5–level frontier. Testers (Mr_Salio / joehansen / XFreeze Sep 4): SpaceX supplemental training (rockets, Raptor, Starship, Starlink, manufacturing, orbital systems) — framed as inheriting SpaceX engineering DNA; larger 2.1T stack expected better + more token-efficient; days away. Testers (joehansen): 4.6 stays 1.5T; AA ~61 with Sol; API $2/$6 vs Sol $5/$30.
- Testers (mark_k, tetsuoai): Grok 4.7 ~September 12 based on Elon's "10 days" timeline; expected 2.1T with improved coding and writing (anticipation).
- Testers (testerlabor, MarioNawfal Sep 5): Grok 4.7 coming next week / around the corner - 2.1T (+40% / +600B vs 4.6); SpaceX engineering data; persistent Grok Bot cloud teams; Elon: will exceed all current models.
- Testers (testerlabor, Mr_Salio, ElonEconomyX Sep 6): Grok 4.7 Beta Sat Sep 12 / next week first look; 2.1T (+600B vs 4.6); frames possible beat of GPT-6 Astra at ~10x cheaper; SpaceX supplemental data; better reasoning/coding/agents; initial training done.
- Testers (bridgebench): frames 4.6 as the turning point for real workflows; claims fastest / cheapest flagship on BridgeBench (~0.1 behind GPT 5.6 Sol); expects 4.7 (2.1T) to be a frontier coding model (opinion).
- Testers (joehansen): on an agent-task board (Gmail/Sheets/Slack/Salesforce/Zendesk/Jira/HubSpot), Grok 4.5 high ~80% objectives (~$0.38/task) vs Gemini 3.7 Flash high ~80% (~$0.19); notes 4.6 is not on that board.
- Testers (Thisiskeena, XFreeze, joehansen, teslaownersSV): LatchBio biosecurity benchmark — Grok 4.6 only model above 50% on both refusing disguised bio threats (59.2%) and completing legitimate research (64.8%); avg 62.1% across harnesses (MiniSWE 64.2%, Pi 63.0%, Grok Build 59.0%); pathogen surveillance 53.5% (ahead of GPT-5.6 Sol); intent/reasoning over blanket filters; near frontier on therapeutics / variant / epigenomics / spatial / single-cell.
- Bookmark testers: Grok 5.0 is the AGI-scale bet, still training on Colossus II (~220k GPUs). Testers (joehansen, testerlabor Sep 3): still training on ~6T & ~10T at Colossus 2 (world's largest AI supercluster framing); several times the 4.7 stack; expected end of year.
- Usage resets: grab a reset token in Grok settings. Testers: weekly resets do not stack; use them before the next one lands.
- Testers (LaceyPresley): SuperGrok Heavy credits can burn mid-week (reset Saturday) — compute/power rationing, not model capability, is the felt bottleneck.
- Lineage testers cite: Grok 1 · 1.5 · 2 · 3 · 4 · 4.1 · 4.2 · 4.3 · 4.5 · 4.6.
- Elon launch post:

HOW TO USE
- Testers (wholemars Sep 14): soon use Grok in Tesla vehicles to send text messages from your phone.
- Testers (XFreeze Sep 14): asked Grok for everything about iOS 27; suggested opting into Siri AI (beta rollout).
- Testers (ray4tesla Sep 14): Grok pinned exact Supercharger photo location / street address from business signage (also ChatGPT).
- Testers (XFreeze Sep 12): Usage page tracks Grok and Grok Bot pools together (separate limits/resets).
- Testers (aksheyd Sep 9): `/learn` in Grok Build — local traces · proposes harness updates (new skills, fix stale, delete unused skills/plugins/MCPs); interactive.
- Testers (XFreeze Sep 8): connectors auto-suggested in-chat — ask without a connector and Grok shows the connection card inside the conversation.
- Chat in the Grok iOS/Android app, https://t.co/UvO8aC6o4n / Grok on the web, or the Grok entry on X.
- Build mode lives in the Grok app: swipe Ask / Imagine / Build on the home screen (app v1.4.24). One-line game prompts work from a phone (cb_doge).
- Testers (SPAC89): same prompt on Grok 4.6 xHigh — Build output quality much better than Cursor; cites Build context window 500K vs Cursor 256K as a likely reason.
- Voice: talk, share your screen (iOS, Android, web) and get live help on what you are looking at (XFreeze, Aug 5). Testers (aegeantic): latest update adds Aurora and Liora.
- Voice connector: voice memos, a personalized daily podcast, or a daily-brief automation. Official grok (Aug 10): on iOS, Android, and web with no extra setting.
- iPhone Action Button can be bound to the standalone Grok app (Settings · Action Button) after you update the app.
- Paste a video link; Grok watches, summarizes, and answers without an upload (cb_doge).
- Testers (dvorahfr Sep 7): asked Grok to explain electromagnetism and plasma engines (teaching / science-explain demo with media).
- Record a note and submit in the app (voice-to-Grok, Feb 2026 grok).
- CAD: official grok nudge to use 4.6 for CAD.
- Automations: email triggers (sender / recipient / subject) so an incoming mail starts a task (XFreeze).
- Testers (niccruzpatane): Tesla 2026 Summer Update — Grok on the car control panel (adjust settings, guide through menus, play music; ambient lighting pulses white). Tesla says it uses Grok Think Fast 2.0 (#1 Artificial Analysis Speech-to-Speech).
- Testers (SawyerMerritt): in the Tesla Summer Update you can give Grok a batch of car commands at once (fold mirrors, wipers, temp, open self-driving app, open glovebox) and it runs them together.
- Testers (XFreeze, Sep 4): “Hey Grok” is becoming native in the Tesla experience — talk to the car for nav, Superchargers/places, calls/texts, music, climate, seat heat/cool, glovebox, settings, Tesla Q&A, plus normal Grok chat; choose voices and personalities.

GROK APP / https://t.co/B4DJ9N0bzA

SAFETY / LIMITS

USEFUL WORKFLOWS

Ling-3.0-flash-Fin, Ant Group’s new finance-focused open weights model, scores 23 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index and 24 on the Finance & Accounting Index, and is on the Intelligence vs. Active Parameter Pareto Frontier

@AntLingAGI has released Ling-3.0-flash-Fin, a finance-focused model built on Ling-3.0-flash. Ant Group announced that it developed the model with financial institutions and industry experts to support financial research, including checking sources, building valuation spreadsheets and writing reports. This text-only model comes after their release of their image and video input-capable model Ling-3.0-flash-VL, which scored 25 on the Intelligence Index.

Key results:

➤ Ling-3.0-flash-Fin matches MiniMax-M2.7’s Intelligence Index score with roughly half the active parameters. Both score 23, while Flash-Fin activates 5.1B parameters per token compared with MiniMax-M2.7’s 10B.

➤ Ling-3.0-flash-Fin matches Ling-3.0-flash-VL at 24 on the Artificial Analysis Finance & Accounting Index. Fin has higher business knowledge accuracy than VL (17% vs. 11%), but also higher business knowledge hallucination (33% vs. 19%)

➤ Ling-3.0-flash-Fin scores slightly below Ling-3.0-flash-VL on professional knowledge work. It scores 1171 Elo on GDPval-AA v2 and 967 on AA-Briefcase, compared with 1225 and 986 respectively for Ling-3.0-flash-VL. Both benchmarks test agents on professional tasks such as producing documents and spreadsheets.

➤ Difficult agentic tasks remain a challenge for Ling-3.0-flash-Fin. It scores 7% on AutomationBench-AA, which tests workflows across business apps while respecting guardrails, compared with 16% for the flash-VL model. Both models score 0% on Terminal-Bench v4.0, which tests difficult terminal-use tasks.

➤ Ling-3.0-flash-Fin uses more output tokens than the flash-VL model and MiniMax-M2.7. It averages ~67k output tokens per Intelligence Index task, about 34% more than VL (~50k) and 3.2x MiniMax-M2.7 (~21k).

Additional model details:

➤ Type: Open weights reasoning model.

➤ Size: 124B total parameters, 5.1B active per token (MoE).

➤ Context window: 256K tokens.

➤ Modalities: Text input and output.

➤ API availability: Available through @OpenRouter, including a rate-limited free endpoint.

➤ License: MIT.

Most AI video tools are still focused on one workflow: enter a prompt, generate a video, then start over whenever something needs to change.

But @ViduAI_official is already pushing beyond basic generation with Vidu S2—toward a real-time interactive video ecosystem where the content can change while the video is being generated.

There are five technical upgrades making this possible:

1.Backbone–Refiner architecture produces structure and motion with parallel refinement for real-time 720P output.
  
2.Timestamp-aligned positional encoding enables  seamless integration of reference images into motion and lighting.
  
3. An upgraded VLM Agent monitors video progress and plans subsequent actions.
  
4. Reinforcement learning applied to the causal model maintains training improvements during deployment. 
 
5. Real-time editing of style, outfit, character and background avoids full regeneration.

This could unlock entirely new experiences across live streaming, gaming, entertainment, and e-commerce.

Imagine viewers using comments to change a streamer’s outfit, character, or environment in real time; a person moving continuously between anime, gaming and cinematic worlds; or fashion models trying on different branded outfits live while the campaign style changes around them.

That feels less like simply generating a video and more like interacting with—and directing—a living video world as it unfolds.
